purpose.es: Reconstrucción bilingüe, actor-específica y fuente-específica de la relación entre el perímetro histórico Montelanza/Molina/Comunidad, la Administración Concursal, el Ministerio Fiscal y la posterior convergencia con CAM/Acosta Matos; incluye E.G. 745/2026 y matriz de remedios.
purpose.en: Bilingual, actor-specific and source-specific reconstruction of the historical Montelanza/Molina/Community perimeter, the insolvency administration, the Public Prosecution Service and later convergence with CAM/Acosta Matos; includes E.G. 745/2026 and remedies matrix.

governing_rules: Identity is not conduct; relationship is not agreement; chronology is not causation; benefit is not participation.
A complaint, prosecution act or party pleading proves that an allegation was made, not that the allegation was true.
A later adoption or reuse of a proposition is a new evidential event and must be sourced separately.
Do not describe Fiscalía, the insolvency administrator or any private perimeter as a criminal organisation absent actor-specific proof of offence elements, structure, purpose and knowledge.
Distinguish whole-hotel economic integration from legal identity of LPB, CEXP, Owners' Community, Pink/Monterecco, Matkator, CAM and individual owners.

proof_scale.DIRECT_PRIMARY: Signed/official or native primary source directly proves the stated act/content within its scope.
proof_scale.CORROBORATED: Multiple independent or source-controlled records support the proposition, subject to stated limits.
proof_scale.ATTRIBUTED: Party/witness/professional allegation or position; proves attribution, not truth.
proof_scale.ANALYTICAL_INFERENCE: Reasoned hypothesis drawn from sourced facts; requires independent proof before use as fact.
proof_scale.OPEN_GAP: Specified source or bridge not yet located/controlled.
proof_scale.CONTRARY_OR_LIMITING: Evidence that narrows, contradicts or supplies an innocent/lawful alternative.

controlling_findings.label: Earliest verified Fiscalía involvement
controlling_findings.finding: The controlled record begins Fiscalía involvement in 2013, not 2012. The 2012 layer is pre-prosecution factual/insolvency history unless a 2012 Fiscal act is later produced.

controlling_findings.label: AC→Fiscalía first-frame transmission
controlling_findings.finding: The source record directly supports an AC-originated transmission into Fiscalía and an official 27-Dec-2013 querella against Gil/Patricia. The prosecution act does not establish the truth of the AC hypotheses.

controlling_findings.label: Predecessor private-perimeter intersection
controlling_findings.finding: By 24-Feb-2015 Roque Prieto, Amenem and Inversiones Salinetas were formally admitted as private accusers in DP 332/2014, creating a documented procedural intersection with the earlier Molina/Montelanza-side perimeter.

controlling_findings.label: Adverse-frame feedback / institutional reuse
controlling_findings.finding: The 7-May-2019 DI 248 archive expressly reused the Ministerio Fiscal's adverse calificación position against the complainant when deciding a complaint against AC/CAM. This is a proved inter-file return path; improper motive remains unproved.

controlling_findings.label: Successor convergence, not identity merger
controlling_findings.finding: Documented title, Community and representation bridges support later functional convergence from parts of the predecessor perimeter into the CAM/Acosta Matos environment; they do not prove one legal merger, one uninterrupted agreement or transferred intent.

controlling_findings.label: E.G.745 reframing issue
controlling_findings.finding: The 29-Sep decree can describe the specific files/issues raised, yet largely answers them as an impermissible merits-review request. The key judicial-review question is whether discrete Article 13 processing/practice/provenance requests were lawfully and sufficiently addressed without converting Inspection into an appellate prosecutor.

attacks_or_adverse_language.wording: redactado de forma confusa e incoherente
attacks_or_adverse_language.assessment: Direct adverse characterization of the presentation's quality; not an accusation of dishonesty.
Frequency framing; not itself a finding of vexatiousness.

attacks_or_adverse_language.wording: convertir a la Inspección Fiscal en una instancia revisora
attacks_or_adverse_language.assessment: Substantive recharacterization of the requested exercise; compare against the express non-merits and provenance/processing requests.

attacks_or_adverse_language.wording: no ha puesto en ningún momento de manifiesto una concreta actuación ... irregular
attacks_or_adverse_language.assessment: Categorical specificity rejection; must be tested against the acts/dates/files the decree itself summarizes.
Reframes allegations as disagreement with outcomes; compare with document-handling/routing/corpus questions.

adverse_evidence_and_falsification.point: Central 6-Feb-2012 agreement and alleged later non-payment/non-collection occurred after Gil's arrival and required independent scrutiny.
A 2016 email thanking the AC for collaboration can support a non-collusive reading for at least part of the chronology; any stronger allegation must identify a later turning point.
Sentencia 163/2023 rejected some AC theories but retained materially adverse findings; the appeal must be treated as live, not as if all adverse findings disappeared.
No controlled source proves a bribe, quid pro quo, direct instruction by Montelanza/Molina to a prosecutor, or one continuous criminal agreement from 2008 to CAM.
The 2014 counter-complaints and 2018 DI248 filings are party positions; their detail does not prove their allegations.
Finca 8718/AP89 unit-453 mapping is internally conflicted and must be reconciled before claiming full 18/18 successor transfer.
Different complaints may lawfully receive different treatment due to different offences, proof and jurisdiction; asymmetry is a research question until investigative intensity is reconstructed.

actions.action: Protect and verify the interposition deadline; counsel to confirm legally effective notification date. Working protective date: 1-Dec-2026 if 1-Oct-2026 controls.
actions.limit: Working date only, not certified deadline.

actions.action: Prepare short-form interposition identifying the 29-Sep decree and attaching representation/act as required.
Use the court's administrative-file requisition to obtain the complete authenticated E.G.745 expediente and index.
Audit the court-delivered expediente against the 10 REGAGE receipts, 27 PDFs, separate 20-Sep filing, email intake and internal routing; request completion promptly if incomplete.

Build demand around source-to-decision matrix: Article 13 practice/processing powers vs merits-review characterization; motivation/congruence; individual response to I01-I07 and otrosíes; treatment of 20-Sep separate filing; corpus/routing/identity; factual premise errors and post-correction treatment.
legal_basis: RD305/2022 art.13; LJCA art.56; LPAC motivation/congruence as counsel confirms

actions.action: Assess narrowly tailored interim evidence-preservation or other effective-relief measure only if counsel can show concrete risk that execution/non-preservation would defeat the appeal.
actions.limit: Do not seek generic suspension merely because the challenged act is an archive decision.

actions.action: Prepare a materially separate Article-13/165 communication limited to new post-archive handling facts, unresolved 20-Sep preservation filing, exact actor/act/duty records and processing-practice issues; expressly state it is not a second reposición or merits appeal.
actions.limit: No guarantee of reopening; avoid duplicating decided object.

actions.action: Demand/seek through lawful channels the signed 29-Jul-2026 DP1901 Fiscal report, author, reparto/asignación, corpus, visado/instructions and remittal chain.
Obtain certified complete DI273/2013 and DP332/2014 files, especially certified AC 18-Sep-2013 intake, investigative acts, Fiscal history and signed final 2021 disposition/finality.
Obtain complete certified DI248/2018 file and build requested-vs-performed diligence matrix before alleging non-investigation.

If facts and professional-context standing fall within Ley 2/2023, lodge a focused external-channel communication and, where justified, request available protection measures concerning post-law retaliation/current risk.
actions.limit: Does not retroactively convert 2013 acts into retaliation and does not substitute for the Supreme Court appeal.

actions.action: Frame a systemic/process complaint around institutional handling, access, traceability and effective-administration concerns, not as a request to overturn a judicial or prosecutorial merits decision.
actions.limit: Complaint does not suspend legal deadlines; justice-function complaints may be routed to MF/CGPJ.

actions.action: In Supreme Court pleadings expressly preserve any genuinely engaged fundamental-right complaints at the earliest procedural opportunity so a later amparo route is not prejudiced.
actions.limit: Amparo is subsidiary and not a merits appeal.

actions.action: Ask counsel to identify any genuine, outcome-material EU-law question—especially whistleblower/effective-remedy scope—and, if present, invite the Supreme Court to consider Article 267 TFEU reference.
actions.limit: No artificial EU-law issue; Charter applies to Member States only when implementing EU law.

actions.action: If a systemic national practice can be tied to EU law, consider a Commission infringement complaint after national route planning.
actions.limit: Commission cannot annul the Spanish decree or award individual compensation; complaint does not suspend national deadlines.

actions.action: If the matter falls within EU fields and directly affects petitioner, consider a carefully redacted PETI petition focused on systemic EU-law implementation/protection issues.
actions.limit: Petitions are potentially public; coordinate privacy and litigation strategy.

actions.action: If evidence identifies fraud/serious irregularity with potential negative impact on EU public funds, prepare a separate funds-specific referral.
actions.limit: OLAF cannot investigate a purely national fraud with no EU financial impact.

actions.action: If reasonable grounds arise for an intentional PIF offence affecting EU financial interests, prepare an EPPO report using only the EU-financial-interest module.
actions.limit: EPPO is not a general forum for national institutional misconduct.

actions.action: After exhaustion of effective domestic remedies, assess a distinct Convention application and four-month clock from final domestic decision.
actions.limit: Strasbourg is not a fourth-instance merits appeal.

actions.action: Create immutable evidence escrow: native binaries, SHA-256/SHA-512, source metadata, chain of custody, notarised/certified copies where proportionate, and a source-to-proposition ledger.
Commission independent proposition-provenance audit of AC→Fiscalía→court/Fiscalía reuse, plus forensic accounting/payment/set-off review of Pink/rent and Community obligations.
Close seller→finca→deed→Registry→CAM chain for all AP89-linked units; resolve Finca 8718/unit453 and 503/908 ownership discrepancies.
Maintain a formal right-of-reply/correction channel and invite source-backed corrections from named actors/institutions; preserve versions and dates.
Create one counsel pack with issue matrix, chronology, proof grades, source hashes, administrative-file checklist, constitutional/EU preservation prompts and draft relief requests.

institutional_posture.subject: Ministerio Fiscal / Fiscalía
institutional_posture.formulation: Treat documented prosecutorial handling as potentially producing a shielding effect around the Acosta Matos position; do not state institutional membership in the Acosta Matos perimeter as fact.
proof_boundary: No coordination, common purpose, bribery, influence payment or knowing protection inferred without actor-specific proof.
Office-level posture does not establish personal knowledge or responsibility.
Archive, referral, silence, adverse reasoning or hierarchy do not by themselves prove criminality.
institutional_posture.deadline_rule: No parallel route is assumed to suspend the Supreme Court judicial-review clock.
